payload: business + sourceRefs on one module-level work/node@2 index.yaml
completion: Review proof and current .starciwork validation only; never implementation, Sonar or UAT pass.
handoff: Downstream consumes accepted requirement/AC/flow IDs unchanged and architecture code/service/security scope by reference. Missing decisions block the affected handoff.

action.en: Resolve the canonical .starciwork workspace and selected business leaf. Research accepted intent, domain documents and current FE/BE callers at exact revisions. Classify every citation as accepted intent, observed source, proposal or unknown; source behavior never approves policy.

Write objective, glossary, actors, ownership, FR/BR and measurable NFRs. Separate output from persisted effects and technical constraints from business policy. Preserve unknown numeric targets with the decision owner; never invent targets.

Write ordered flows with entry, actor, prerequisites, request, response/error, transitions, guards, side effects and postconditions. Cover success, invalid/denied input, retry, duplicate, concurrency, cancellation and recovery where relevant; mark non-applicability with reasons.

Trace each flow to observed UI/API/module/store callers and affected services. Record a preliminary codeImpacts/serviceImpacts inventory, source citations, direct versus transitive impact, preserve/change/review disposition and unknowns. This is architecture input, not authorization to edit every discovered file.

Specify actor-action-resource permissions, tenant/owner boundaries, sensitive-data handling and abuse cases. Give each security requirement an observable denial/no-side-effect acceptance scenario; do not mistake a disabled UI control for server enforcement.

Write one compact module-level business object in canonical index.yaml. Use plain requirement titles and behavior, ordered actor/action/systemResponse flow steps, measurable nonFunctionalRequirements and Given/When/Then acceptanceCriteria. Keep unknown targets in unresolvedQuestions instead of inventing an SLA. Put observed repository citations in sourceRefs and graph bindings in refs/dependsOn; do not create per-clause IDs or hide the SRS in Markdown description.

Validate coverage and .starciwork bindings; review all unresolved decisions together. Output requirements, ordered flows, acceptance, preliminary impact and security inputs for architecture/draw/planning. No automatic secondary call is defined for this op; report a missing decision and do not invent a helper. Complete only this reviewed business scope.
